description: This file defines an interface 'AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger' that extends SLF4J's Logger with auto-close capabilities and MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management for enhanced logging functionality, including setting/discarding correlation IDs and MDC entries.

classes.name: AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger
classes.description: An interface that extends SLF4J Logger with auto-close features and MDC management methods, including setting/discarding correlation IDs and diagnostic context entries.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for log operations until discarded; supports method chaining.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the previously set correlation ID from the MDC.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates a MDC entry with the given key and value for subsequent log statements.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a MDC entry identified by the specified key from the context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the logger, performing cleanup if necessary.
